title: A Primer of the Glaive Grip
summary: Teaches a first-time student how to hold, balance and carry the glaive and to make its simplest cuts.

title: Drill-Book of the Crescent Sweep
summary: Sets out daily drills for the low, middle and high sweeps of the curved blade for students with toughening skin.

title: Handbook for the Long Curved Blade
summary: Explains how far a glaive reaches and how to slide the hands along the shaft to use that reach.

title: Workbook of Wheel and Draw Cuts
summary: A workbook of wheeling guards and drawing cuts that needs the supple wrists and forearms of a tendon-stage body.

title: Plain Guide to Glaive Footing
summary: Teaches the stances, advances, turns and retreats that keep a long blade steady for students with dense, strong bones.

title: Treatise on the Shaft and Butt Cap
summary: Covers the use of the shaft and the iron-capped butt for shoving, blocking and tripping when the blade is shut out.

title: Elementary Canon of Qi-Warmed Cuts
summary: Shows a student who has just begun to circulate qi how to warm the glaive's edge and shaft.

title: Manual of the Breathing Sweep
summary: Links each sweep, cut and guard of the glaive to a breath so the qi stays even through long drills.

title: Handbook of the Steady Glaive Line
summary: Teaches a short set of straight-line cuts, thrusts and guards that keep the glaive true while qi flows through it.

title: Reader of Crescent Edge and Spine
summary: Teaches the difference between the cutting belly and the parrying spine of the blade, with qi laid on each.

title: Short Course in Reach and Recovery
summary: Teaches a student to reach with the glaive and recover the guard before an opponent can answer the cut.
